'''Garon Borm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]] who fought during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. He also served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Kandosii-type dreadnaught|''Kandosii''-type dreadnaught]] known as ''[[Parjai]]''. When he attempted to stop [[Dorjander Kace]]'s plan to take the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Zayne Carrick]] and the rest of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were able trick Garon and his crew into thinking that there had been a "[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Brain fever", forcing the crew to leave the ship while the Republic prisoners took over it.
